4300:
** προκῡρόομαι**,
_passive_, **to be ratified** or **confirmed before,** ἐν τῷ -κεκυρωμένῳ ψαφίσματι {{Refs 2nd c.BC+|“Supp.epigram” 3.674 A 28 (Rhodes, 2nd c.BC)}}; διαθήκη -κεκυρωμένη ὑπὸ τοῦ εοῦ {{NT|NT.Gal.3.17}}:—_middle_, {{Refs|Anonymus “Prog.” in Rhetores Graeci 1.605 W.}}
4303:
** προμαρτύρομαι** [ῡ],
**bear witness to beforehand,** τὰ εἰς Χριστὸν παθήματα {{NT|NT.1Pet.1.11.}}
4309:
** προορ-ίζω**,
**determine beforehand,** ἡμέραν {{Refs 3rd c.AD+|3rd c.AD: Heliodorus Scriptor Eroticus 7.24}}; **predetermine, predestine,** ἡμᾶς εἰς υἱοθεσίαν {{NT|NT.Eph.1.5; τι γενέσθαι NT.Act.4.28}}; τινὰς συμμόρφους (i.e. γενέσθαι) {{NT|NT.Rom.8.29.}}
4310:
** προπάσχω**,
**suffer first** or **beforehand,** {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Herodotus Historicus 7.11, 5th c.BC: Thucydides Historicus 3.82, etc.}}; τι {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Sophocles Tragicus “Oedipus Coloneus” 230 (Lyric poetry), 5th c.BC: Antipho Orator 2.1.5, 5th-6th c.BC: Plato Philosophus “Respublica” 376a}}; **to be ill-treated before,** ὑφ᾽ ἡμῶν {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Thucydides Historicus 3.67; π. οὐδὲν ἀγαθόν 5th-6th c.BC: Xenophon Historicus “Memorabilia” 2.2.5}}: generally, **to be previously affected** or **modified,** {{Refs 1st c.AD+|1st-2nd c.AD: Plutarchus Biographus et Philosophus 2.725a, 3rd c.AD: Plotinus Philosophus 4.5.2.}}
4315:
** προσάββᾰτον**, τό,
**eve of the sabbath,** {{LXX+NT|LXX.Jdt.8.6, NT.Mark.15.42}}, **Bull.Inst.franc. d'Arch.orientale** {{Refs|30.5.}}
4321:
** προσᾰν-ᾱλίσκω**,
_future_ -ανᾱλώσω, **lavish** or **consume besides**, καὶ τὰ τῶν φίλων π. {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th-6th c.BC: Plato Philosophus “Protagoras” 311d; τὰς ἰδίας οὐσίας 4th c.BC: Demosthenes Orator 20.10, compare 2nd-3rd c.AD: Dio Cassius Historicus 43.18; π. οὐκ ὀλίγα χρήματα “IG” 22.834.7}}; π. χρόνον ἱστοῖς **waste further** time **on.. **, {{Refs 3rd c.AD+|3rd c.AD(?): Diogenes Laertius 6.98; μισθούς τινι 3rd c.AD: Porphyrius Tyrius Philosophus “de Abstinentia - Porphyrii Opuscula” 1.56.}}
4322:
** προσανα-πληρόω**,
**fill up, replenish besides**, τὸν ἐνδεέστατον βίον {{NT+4th c.BC+|4th c.BC: Aristoteles Philosophus “Politica” 1256b3, compare 1st c.BC: Diodorus Siculus Historicus 5.71; τὴν λείπουσαν ταῖς βασάνοις κόλασιν LXX.Wis.19.4; τὰ ὑστερήματα τῶν ἁγίων NT.2Cor.9.12, compare 1st c.AD: Philo Judaeus 2.444; τὰ ἐλλείποντα 2nd c.AD: Apollonius Dyscolus Grammaticus “de Pronominibus;” 3.7}}:—_middle_, **add so as to fill up**, {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th-6th c.BC: Plato Philosophus “Meno” 84d.}}
4324:
** προσαπ-ειλέω**, τινι
**threaten besides**, Test. cited in {{Refs 4th c.BC+|4th c.BC: Demosthenes Orator 21.93}}:—_passive_, variant in {{LXX|LXX.Sir.13.3.}}
4325:
** προσδᾰπᾰνάω**,
**spend besides,** {{NT+2nd c.AD+|Inscriptiones Graecae 22.949.10, 1227.8, NT.Luke.10.35, 2nd c.AD: Lucianus Sophista “Ep.Sat.” 39}}:—_middle_, {{Refs 4th c.AD+|4th c.AD: Themistius Sophista “Orationes” 23.289b.}}
4343:
** προσκαρτέρ-ησις**, εως, ἡ,
**perseverance, patience**, {{NT+5th c.BC+|1st c.BC: Philodemus Gadarensis Epigrammaticus “Rh.” 1.11 5th c.BC: Sophocles Tragicus, NT.Eph.6.18.}}
4345:
** προσκληρόω**,
**allot, assign, attribute**, ἀκοσμίαν τινί {{Refs 1st c.BC+|1st c.BC: Philodemus Philosophus “περὶ τῶν Στωικῶν” 339.16; τούτῳ τῷ βίῳ ἡ τύχη π. σε 2nd c.AD: Lucianus Sophista “Am.” 3}}:—_middle_, _future_ -ώσομαι, τιμὴν αὑτῷ {{Refs 1st c.AD+|1st c.AD: Philo Judaeus 1.339}}:—_passive_, **to be assigned**, {{Refs 1st c.AD+|[prev. author] 2.366, 381, 1st c.AD: Josephus Historicus “Bellum Judaicum” 2.20.4}}; also, **to be attached to**, Παύλῳ {{NT|NT.Act.17.4.}}
4353:
** προσκῠν-ητής**, οῦ, ὁ,
**worshipper,** {{NT+3rd c.AD+|NT.John.4.23, “OGI” 262.21 (Baetocaece, 3rd c.AD), 6th c.AD: Procopius Caesariensis Historicus “de Aedificiis” 5.7.}}
4354:
** προσλᾰλ-έω**,
**talk to** or **with**, τινι {{Refs 4th c.BC+|4th c.BC: Antiphanes Comicus 218.3, 4th c.AD: Heniochus Comicus 4.3: _absolutely_, 4th-3rd c.BC: Theophrastus Philosophus “Characteres” 7.5, “PMich.Zen.” 80.5, 7 (3rd c.BC)}}; π. ἑαυτῷ τὰ Πινδαρικά {{Refs 1st c.AD+|1st-2nd c.AD: Plutarchus Biographus et Philosophus 2.602f.}}
4358:
** προσορμ-ίζω**,
**bring** a ship **to anchor at** or **near**, Κνίδῳ προσορμίσαι (i.e. τὴν ναῦν) {{Refs 2nd c.BC+|2nd c.AD: Lucianus Sophista “Am.” 11, compare “PTeb.” 802.11 (2nd c.BC)}}; π. τοῖς αἰγιαλοῖς {{Refs 1st c.BC+|4th c.AD: Iamblichus Philosophus “de vita Pythagorica” 3.14; πρὸς τὴν Σιφνίων χώραν “IG” 12(5).653.12 (Syros, perhaps 1st c.BC)}}:—in early writers only _middle_, **come to anchor near** a place, ἔα τὰς νέας πρὸς τὴν Δῆλον προσορμίζεσθαι {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Herodotus Historicus 6.97}}; πρὸς τουτους (i.e. λιμένας) μὴ προσορμίζου {{Refs 4th c.BC+|4th c.BC: Demosthenes Orator 25.84}}; ποῖ οὖν προσορμιούμεθ; {{Refs 1st c.AD+|[prev. author] 4.44; προσορμισάμενος τῇ Σαμοθρᾴκῃ 1st-2nd c.AD: Plutarchus Biographus et Philosophus “Aemilius Paulus” 26}}:—later in _passive_, προσορμισθεὶς τῷ αἰγιαλῷ {{NT+1st c.AD+|2nd c.AD: Arrianus Historicus “Anabasis” 6.20.4, compare 1st-2nd c.AD: Plutarchus Biographus et Philosophus 2.601f; τῇ Νάξῳ προσωρμίσθη 2nd-3rd c.AD: Aelianus “Varia Historia” 8.5, cf. NT.Mark.6.53: _metaphorically_, π. τοῖς μύθοις 2nd-3rd c.AD: Philostratus Sophista “Heroicus” 11; εὐγένειαι π. τοῖς φαυλοτάτοις 1st c.AD: Philo Judaeus 2.38 (nisi to be read προσοριζ-).}}
4361:
** πρόσπεινος**, ον,
(πεῖνα) **hungry**, {{NT+1st c.AD+|1st c.AD: Demosthenes Ophthalmicus Medicus cited in 6th c.AD: Aëtius Medicus 7.33, NT.Act.10.10.}}
4362:
** προσπήγνῡμι**,
_future_ -πήξω (προσπήξομαι is _falsa lectio_ for{-πτύξομαι} in {{Refs 5th c.AD+|5th c.AD(?): Hesychius Legal icographus)}}:—**fix to** or **on**, τινί [τι] {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Euripides Tragicus “Fragmenta” 679, etc.; τι πρός τι 2nd-3rd c.AD: Dio Cassius Historicus 40.9; ἥλοις [τὸν ἀκινάκην] τῷ κολεῷ προσέπηξε [prev. author] 63.2}}: _absolutely_, _crucify,_{{NT|NT.Acts.2.23}}:—_passive_ with _perfect_ _active_ -πέπηγα, **to be fixed on**, {{Refs 1st c.AD+|1st-2nd c.AD: Heliodorus Medicus cited in 4th c.AD: Oribasius Medicus 49.4.72; περί τι 2nd-3rd c.AD: Dio Cassius Historicus 45.17; ἰχθῦς -πεπηγὼς τῷ ἀγκίστρῳ 5th c.AD: Aristaenetus Rhetor 1.7.}}
4368:
** πρόστᾰτ-ις**, ιδος,
_feminine_ of προστάτης, ἐὰν.. θέληθ᾽ ὁμοῦ προστάτισι ταῖς σεμναῖσι.. θεαῖς (Dind. for ἐὰν.. θέλητέ μου πρὸς ταῖσι ταῖς σ.) {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Sophocles Tragicus “Oedipus Coloneus” 458}}; προστάτιν ἐπιγράφεσθαί τινα {{Refs 2nd c.AD+|2nd c.AD: Lucianus Sophista “Bis Acc.” 29; ὁ δῆμος ἀρχὴν ἑαυτοῦ π. ἀπέφηνε καὶ ἐκάλεσε δημαρχίαν 2nd c.AD: Appianus Historicus “Bella Civilia” 1.1; νύμφαις ὑδάτων προστάτισιν 3rd c.AD: Porphyrius Tyrius Philosophus “de Antro Nympharum - Porphyrii Opuscula” 12, compare 18, 2nd c.AD: Lucianus Sophista “Charid.” 10}}; τὴν ἰδίαν π., of Rhea, probably in {{Refs|“CIG” “Corpus Inscriptionum Graecarum” “Corpus Inscriptionum Graecarum” 6835 (uncertain _locative_); π. τοῦ Ἀνούβεως “PMag.Osl.” 1.338.}}
4378:
** πρόσ-χῠσις**, εως, ἡ,
**pouring upon, sprinkling**, τοῦ αἵματος {{NT|NT.Heb.11.28.}}
4379:
** προσ-ψαύω**,
_Doric dialect_ and _poetry_ **ποτι-**, **touch upon, touch**, τιμαῖς {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Pindarus Lyricus “Fragmenta.” 121.3: with _genitive_, 2nd-3rd c.AD: Aelianus “De Natura Animalium - Ar.Byzantine Epit.” 1.57: _absolutely_, 5th c.BC: Sophocles Tragicus “Philoctetes” 1054, “OC” 329; ὅσον γ᾽ ἂν αὐτὸς μὴ ποτιψαύων χεροῖν [prev. author] “Tr..” 1214:}} —_passive_, {{Refs 1st c.AD+|1st c.AD: Dioscorides (Dioscurides) Medicus “Eup.” 1.167.}}
4380:
** προσωπο-ληπτέω**,
(see. πρόσωπον 1.1) **to be a respecter of persons,** {{NT|NT.Jam.2.9.}}
4382:
** προσωπο-ληψία**, ἡ,
**respect of persons,** {{NT|NT.Rom.2.11, NT.Col.3.25, NT.Jam.2.1 (_plural_).}}
